name: asymmetric_log_normal_pulse_waves
mechanism: Replaces symmetric Gaussian functions with asymmetric log-normal distributions to model systolic and diastolic waves, producing a more physiologically realistic pulse morphology with a steep rise and gradual decay.

name: adjust_log_normal_waveform_parameters
mechanism: Adjusted the log-normal distribution parameters for the systolic and diastolic waves to widen the pulse and better match reference rise time and pulse width.

name: use_asymmetric_gaussian_pulses
mechanism: Replaces log-normal distributions with asymmetric Gaussian functions to model systolic and diastolic waves, allowing independent control over rise time and decay.
code_snippet: np.where(dt < t_sys, amp * np.exp(- (dt - t_sys)**2 / (2 * sigma_sys_left**2)), amp * np.exp(- (dt - t_sys)**2 / (2 * sigma_sys_right**2)))

name: widen_pulse_waveform_components
mechanism: Increases the standard deviations and peak times of the asymmetric Gaussian functions modeling the systolic and diastolic waves to produce a wider, more physiologically realistic pulse waveform.

name: increase_pulse_waveform_width
mechanism: Increases the standard deviations and delays the peak times of the systolic and diastolic asymmetric Gaussian waves to produce a wider overall pulse waveform.
